description: This file defines the ConnectivityMonitorService class, which extends JobIntentService to monitor network connectivity status, including detecting metered, unmetered, and device hotspot states, and provides static methods to register receivers and start the service.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitorService
classes.description: A service class that monitors network connectivity status, including detecting metered, unmetered, and hotspot connections, and provides static methods for registration and starting the service.

methods.name: registerAndStart
methods.description: Registers a BroadcastReceiver to listen for connectivity changes and starts the service.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates an intent to start the ConnectivityMonitorService and enqueues it for execution.

methods.name: getNetworkState
methods.description: Determines the current network state, returning flags indicating no connection, metered, unmetered, or device hotspot without internet.

methods.name: onHandleWork
methods.description: Handles incoming intents; updates the application's network state based on current connectivity.
